strings.en: Problem... detected.
...Space...
It must be... silent...
...Hating one another...
Not wanted.
Not wanted... this world.
Not wanted... this world... correction...
Completion...
...A new... life...
...Failure.
...Awakening... the time to wait...
Captain, no enemies remain nearby. ...We've driven them off for now.
The Vega Star Federation... They're so persistent with their attacks...
...Understood. Sorry, Captain, but we have to set out right away.
Return to the deck. ...Lieutenant Emma, give me a status report.
Yes, sir. To be honest... the situation is tough.
The Vega Star Federation seems to be attacking every colony like that,
and every facility, too.
...Right after the Gryps Conflict ended, huh.
That's the worst possible result of reckless disarmament.
Now, now, Captain, we've got my brother here, so it'll be fine.
Maria, you shouldn't say things you can't back up.
Oh, Brother, welcome back.
Captain, I've returned. We've driven them back for now, but...
I'd say our defensive battle is nearing its limit, wouldn't you?
It's rough. There don't seem to be any working mobile suits left in Luna II,
and with more than half the interception systems down...
Yes... In effect, all that's holding Luna II up is the Captain's Hyaku Shiki,
the Lieutenant's Prototype Unit 1...
It's under maintenance, but next time I can sortie in the Rick Dias.
And Umon's Grendizer. That's all.
And there's the Aphrodite A they forced over here for us...
It's totally not made for space... but beggars can't be choosers.
...Oh, Bright, in this case it's not Umon's,
it's Brother Duke's Grendizer, right?
It's all right, Maria. Earth is my home now.
...So my name is Daisuke Umon.
Then I'm Maria Umon. Hard to say, though.
If all aliens were like you two,
we wouldn't have to fight a war like this.
...Humans went to war just from living apart, on Earth and in colonies...
Perhaps the situation is no different.
Honestly! Captain!
Heh, my apologies. ...Captain, as for our next move...
Right. We, Londo Bell... the Ra Cailum, will now depart Luna II,
follow the lunar orbit, and track the Vega Star Federation's movements.
Don't we know where the Vegans' home base is?
...Probably... near the Moon. Their final goal is the Earth.
They'll want the Moon as a forward base at any cost.
But Umon, that's where Von Braun City
and Anaheim Electronics are, you know?
True, I doubt they could build a base there without anyone noticing...
Brother?
They just might... pull it off.
Captain Bright, it seems we do need to search the area around the Moon.
...We were just attacked, so we can't move right away, but...
on the other hand, we may be able to catch the enemy off guard.
Ummm~
Hm, you're... I see, the one assigned here...
Excellen Browning. Sorry I'm late.
Excellen... Browning. I see, so you're...
? Is that some new pickup line?
No, it's obviously not.
In any case, reinforcements are welcome. But... are you alone?
Yes. My unit's a modified prototype that isn't very versatile,
so I went alone to Anaheim for adjustments...
and came straight here from there.
I've confirmed it.
...PTX-007-03C, Gespenst Mk-II Custom...
I don't love that its output's kind of low, though.
By the way, what about the other reinforcements?
Just you. ...We were expecting reinforcements from Konpeito
and the Satsuki Midori colony, but...
"Were"...? Captain?
...We can't reach Konpeito. And the Satsuki Midori colony...
has gone silent.
Wow, so I'm a lucky girl?
So it would seem. ...We're boxed in on every side.
What about contact with Jaburo, Captain?
We keep trying at regular intervals... but nothing changes.
For now, only the Far East Branch is functioning... the Cyber Beast Force.
The Cyber Beast Force! Captain, let's try contacting them.
We're stuck anyway, right?
Yes... They may have information on Jaburo. All right, open a channel.
(Kyosuke... looks like we both have it rough.)
Hohohohoho! I see it, I see it! How delightful!
How shall I slaughter every creature on this planet... I can hardly wait!
Hoh~ hohohoho.
...And that's the situation, Commander Hazuki.
How awful... But with your current forces...
won't it be difficult to hold back the Vega Star Federation?
I know. But... we have to do it.
What about those Jovian Lizards that appeared on Mars
after the Meganoid Rebellion?
They've made no notable moves lately.
I see... Mysterious unmanned weapons of unknown origin...
Whose machines could they be...?
There are rumors they might be Meganoid survivors...
Mars... Just when it had recovered from the Meganoid Rebellion...
What's still functioning properly there now?
The Mars Frontier Base... It's ironic that the city was built
on the ruins of a Meganoid base.
Captain, the person Captain Bright's talking to is...
Commander Hazuki of the Federation Forces' Far East Branch.
Hazuki... I've heard that name before...
In the last war, as the Muge Zorbados Empire neared the Earth Sphere...
he led the Cyber Beast Force, who stormed their base alone and
succeeded in defeating Emperor Muge. He's their commander.
The Cyber Beast Force! The ones famous for disobeying orders!?
Still, it's the only super robot the military owns.
Though it's not operational now...
That's right. The robots that became famous overnight in the last war,
like Getter Robo and Mazinger Z, have all been mothballed...
What about reinforcements from Konpeito or Satsuki Midori Colony?
Same as Jaburo... We can't get through to them.
Strange... I've heard nothing about that... Then in terms of strength...
Frankly, we're in a tough spot.
Grendizer is somehow keeping us afloat, but...
We simply don't have enough pilots. We were told they'd send us
a new model, but...
all we got was a prototype passed over for production due to cost,
and a single pilot for it.
Same as us. One prototype and its pilot, nothing more...
And that machine is a Gespenst Type 3.
Type 3... I've rarely heard of a Mk-III.
Strictly, it's from the ATX Project, the Personal Trooper upgrade plan.
It was developed using the preserved Unit 3 as its base.
But only one prototype exists. It has power, but it's far too specialized.
Ours is a custom Gespenst Mk-II, the mass-production prototype.
Even with the military cutbacks...
The ATX Project...
Yet to send a canceled machine to the front lines...
What is the top brass thinking...?
I understand. ...Even so,
we intend to hold the line against any descent to Earth at all costs...
I have a proposal.
Add Dancougar... the Cyber Beast Force to Londo Bell.
We've had no proper supplies, and its tuning isn't complete, but...
its combat ability should be more than enough.
Dancougar...!? That'd be welcome, but it's another jurisdiction.
With Jaburo out of contact now...
I can't just move forces around on my own...
Captain. Forgive me for cutting in, but what Commander Hazuki says
may well be right.
Who among our current forces can down a saucer beast in one hit?
is Grendizer.
Dancougar's combat ability was proven in the last war.
...Hmm, but...
...What if they disobeyed orders and went to Londo Bell on their own?
Whoa, Hazuki, so you're telling us to disobey orders?
...Fujiwara.
Hell yeah, let's do it!
Stuck on ground duty like this, I'm gonna go nuts from boredom!
Besides, it's not the first time we've disobeyed orders. Right, Shinobu?
What's that supposed to mean, Sara? Like I'm always...
And there you have it, Captain Bright.
I expect they'll cause you all sorts of trouble... Is that all right?
...Understood. We'd be glad to have them.
Oh, that's right, Commander Hazuki.
Is there something else?
...Commander, there's one thing I should tell you. The pilots assigned
to the Gandor Team and to Londo Bell... both of them are probably...
survivors of that accident.
...Not that it means anything in particular...
In fact, the girl who came to us is a skilled pilot.
...Though her personality seems a bit problematic.
But... why, amid these cutbacks, were they assigned now of all times...
...I understand.
...Though as long as we can't reach Jaburo, there's no way to confirm it...
(That accident... Its only two survivors, Kyosuke Nanbu and
Excellen Browning...)
Huh, so this is Grendizer... These horns are pretty cool. The horns.
Look out! Don't get any closer!
Wh-wh-what!? I didn't do anything!
Whew... It didn't react... Sorry about that.
If anyone besides me gets near Grendizer,
its automatic defense system kicks in.
S-something that dangerous!?
Yes. Grendizer was the guardian deity of planet Fleed.
It's not quite "let sleeping gods lie," but it's protected from misuse.
Brother, what's all the fuss?
Oh my, Excellen, don't tell me you're into my brother...
Maria! How'd you get that idea!?
I only came to do maintenance on the Weiss!
I'm kidding. No need to get so flustered.
Don't tell me... things aren't going well with your boyfriend?
Ugh... W-well, I'll admit he's not exactly friendly, but...
Oops... Hit a nerve...?
That's enough, Maria. ...By the way, what's the matter?
Oh, right... I've got a bad feeling about something.
My sister Maria has a weak power of precognition. So that means, Maria...
All pilots! Report to the bridge! I repeat, pilots to the bridge!
An announcement! She was really right!
Everyone's here. Listen up. The Vega Star Federation...
has begun moving in earnest.
Don't tell me they're after Luna II again!?
No, it seems their attack here was just a preliminary step
to strike every sector.
Could it be... the Satsuki Midori colony too...!?
Quite possibly. Captain, about Jaburo...
...Still no word. And so we can't send units from Luna II either...
Geez, the military is so roundabout.
I agree. But right now, only we can move, as an independent unit...
We depart at once.
...Have other points already been hit?
Yes. A colony cluster... not far from the Moon.
That's where the Vega Star Federation seems to be heading.
Also, this is unconfirmed, but on the far side of the Moon...
a recon probe was destroyed in the shoal zone.
It's hard to believe it just hit an asteroid...
So we're heading there?
Yes. All hands, stand by at your posts. This ship will now...
Captain Bright!!
Hm, what is it, Lieutenant?
A ship with an unknown ID signal is moving toward Earth!
...This... It's not Zeon or the Vega Star Federation...!?
Who is it!? ...Damn, there's no force on the ground to resist invaders.
Are we the only ones who can stop it...!?
So they've begun to move.
Even to a remote planet like this... Those guys! I'll teach 'em a lesson!
That's right! ...Huh, Brother...?
Yes, but... this star system's battle... I can't shake a bad feeling.
I hope it'll be over once we defeat them.
I hear those dreadful space pirates are moving too... Miss, I'm worried...
Honestly, what good will worrying do!?
...We must go. Wherever Kenrou leads us.
